title: Life Admin
body:
life.admin: Organize your head, heart, and pocket in one | BetaList

## Organize your head, heart, and pocket in one calm place

 

life.admin is a calm personal life-planning app for the practical, emotional, and financial parts of everyday life. It brings together tasks, wellbeing, relationships, money, learning, purpose, home, and work across three simple areas: Head, Heart, and Pocket. Choose what deserves your attention today, keep useful plans and reflections in one place, and stay connected to the things that matter without turning every part of life into another productivity system.

I'm a social worker in Australia and built life.admin as an independent maker after wondering whether the different parts of everyday life could live together somewhere simpler, calmer, and more human.

title: Flamekeeper
body:
Flamekeeper: Turn employee departures into structured, | BetaList

## Turn employee departures into structured, reliable knowledge transfer

 

 

 

Flamekeeper helps teams document what an employee knows before they leave. It guides the departing employee through questions about their role, responsibilities, decisions, processes, contacts, and ongoing work, then uses AI to turn their answers into useful handover documents. Managers and teammates participate in knowledge sharing and can review the content, request follow-ups, track tasks, and approve the final handover. Documents can be exported to Google Docs, PDF, Word, or Markdown for storage in your existing knowledge base.

 Kirill

body:
FlowMate: Workflows made simple, no technical skills needed | BetaList

## Workflows made simple, no technical skills needed

 

 

 

 

You already use Claude every day for sales, support, or ops. FlowMate lets it run those workflows instead of just answering questions. Describe a process once in plain language, and Claude carries it through every app you use when you ask or a trigger fires. Unlike n8n, Make, or Zapier, there's no graph to build, no fields to map, and no technical skills needed. You can start right away, straight from a chat with Claude.

title: Journey Jotter
body:
Journey Jotter: Travel journaling in 3 minutes using your | BetaList

## Travel journaling in 3 minutes using your own voice

 

 

 

 

Most travelers want to document their trips, but sitting down to journal every day takes time. Miss a day or two, and you're a week behind. Photos and travel apps are great for remembering where you went, but not what happened. Journey Jotter lets you talk or type about your day, answers with thoughtful prompts, then turns it into a beautiful journal written in your own voice, all in just a few minutes.

BISY: Track sold-out items and auto-buy when they restock | BetaList

## Track sold-out items and auto-buy when they restock

 

BISY helps you secure out-of-stock fashion products by monitoring restocks and auto-purchasing as soon as items return to inventory. Paste a product link, set your size or options, and let BISY’s agents watch the page 24/7. When stock appears, it completes checkout instantly so you beat the rush. Compatible with 10+ retailers and thousands of products, BISY removes the hassle of manual refreshing and ensures you never miss the pieces you love.

# Terrapin: Turn receipts, email & photos into clean, | BetaList

title: Tryterrapin
body:
Terrapin: Turn receipts, email & photos into clean, | BetaList

## Turn receipts, email & photos into clean, tax-ready insights, automatically

 

 

 

 

 

 

Terrapin is a receipt proof automation platform built for freelancers, 1099 contractors, and self-employed workers. We automatically find, match, and organise your business receipts - so you never miss a deduction again.

Most freelancers lose thousands every year to receipts they can't find at tax time. Terrapin fixes that by connecting to the places your receipts already live - your email inbox, bank accounts, and camera roll - and doing the work for you. No manual uploads, no spreadsheets, no shoeboxes.

We match each receipt to the right transaction, categorize it, and separate business from personal expenses. When it's time to file, export a CPA-ready bundle - no chasing, no gaps.

body:
DOER: Professional network with no ads, algorithm, or | BetaList

## Professional network with no ads, algorithm, or commission

 

 

 

 

 

DOER is a professional network built for people who get things done. It has no ads, no algorithm, and zero commission on what members earn. It focuses on four pillars: connect with profiles, groups, an activity feed, and messaging with no sponsored or boosted content. Learn by taking and publishing courses and running your own room as a mentor. Earn by offering services, products, and coaching to other members, keeping 100% of what you charge, minus Stripe fees. Build by listing your business, posting open roles, and finding customers. It's free to join, with paid tiers only for those who want to earn, and you pay nothing until you've earned double the membership through DOER. Built solo.

 Scott Barker

# MyResultLab: Upload scans or lab reports and get instant | BetaList

title: Myresultlab
body:
MyResultLab: Upload scans or lab reports and get instant | BetaList

## Upload scans or lab reports and get instant plain-language answers

 

 

MyResultLab helps patients understand X-rays, CT scans, MRI scans, ultrasounds, and lab reports in clear language. Upload your images or reports to receive an AI-generated explanation of findings, key terms, and questions to discuss with your doctor. The platform uses Google MedGemma 1.5 for multimodal medical understanding with GPT for reasoning and summarization. Data is encrypted, can be deleted anytime, and you can ask unlimited follow-up questions for clarity.

title: Testifly
body:

## Automate end-to-end testing with autonomous AI that maintains tests

 

 

 

 

 

Testifly is an AI-powered end-to-end testing platform that discovers your app’s user flows, generates and maintains tests automatically, and runs across every environment and release. It connects to tools like Jira, Linear, Notion, and Slack, heals brittle tests when UIs change, and provides root-cause reports with session recordings. Teams reduce testing time, catch regressions before production, and scale QA without writing or maintaining test cases.

 Eyal

# SitesRadar: Monitor client websites and get alerts when | BetaList

title: Sitesradar
body:
SitesRadar: Monitor client websites and get alerts when | BetaList

## Monitor client websites and get alerts when anything regresses

 

SitesRadar monitors client websites for freelancers and small agencies and alerts you the moment something gets worse. It checks uptime, SSL and certificate expiry, broken links, redirects, domain and DNS changes, email deliverability, SEO tags, and even leaked file metadata. Then it emails exactly what changed and where. You can add multiple sites, see a single prioritized status view, and avoid noisy “still up” pings. Start free for one site or scale to monitor an entire roster with instant alerts.

### Makers

 Alex
